info.title: Orders Self-Service API (S7 demo mock)
info.description: A minimal customer self-service Orders API used to demo the Abuse & Scraping Classifier. A caller may read only its own order (id 1001 for the demo key); every other id returns 403. This shape makes a sequential-id enumeration walk light up as rising 403s over sequential ids.

get.description: Returns the order if it belongs to the calling customer, otherwise 403. In the A2D mock, configure scenario routing so id=1001 returns 200 with a sample order and any other id returns 403 forbidden — this is what turns an id walk into a high 4xx share the classifier keys on.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric order identifier the caller wants to read.

403.description: The order does not belong to the caller.

get.description: Returns the calling customer's own profile. Used by the normal-client path of the demo to show ordinary, low-rate, low-error traffic that never trips the classifier trigger.
